text:
maria: quick standup — what I did / blockers / today

maria: did: prewarmed us-west lanes for model-x, ran warmup jobs against canary pool. saw quota error when trying to spin +4 GPUs in eu-west trying to increase canary capacity. opened ticket https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-2345 with request details.

maria: blocker: waiting on cloud quota bump for project; until then canary can't scale beyond 5%.

maria: today: follow up with cloud-team, run a targeted warmup for quantized variant if quota doesn't land, and update perf targets in the rollout config.

jon: saw the ticket, added more context (usage pattern & peak window). requested +4 gpus in europe-west1. @lee can you confirm AZ mapping for eu-west so cloud can approve correct AZ quota? :thumbsup:

lee: confirmed AZ mapping — europe-west1 has a/b/c. quota is per-region-project so cloud needs the project+region pair. quick check: `gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --format='json' | jq .quotas` shows current allocations. cc @tara

infra-bot: INFRA-2345: quota bump request received, status -> IN_PROGRESS, assigned to cloud-team, ETA ~3h (automated update)

tara: plan: small warmup for model-x-q8 at 14:30 UTC across us-west and eu-west canaries. if quota doesn't land by then we'll switch to model-x-q4 with smaller batch size. @maria can you paste target p95/tps?

maria: perf targets: p95 token latency < 250ms, target throughput ~120 RPS for canary. fallback plan: model-x-q4, batch_size=8, reduce concurrency to hit latency SLO. rollout config snippet: `canary: {percent: 5, regions: ["us-west1","europe-west1"]}`

jon: i'll ping cloud ops slack thread and escalate if no movement in 30m. also found stale prewarm instances in us-west that were leaking — deletion freed ~8 GPUs 

lee: ran the cleanup script `./scripts/cleanup_prewarm.sh` and reclaimed 7 GPUs. watching for repeat leaks; noted scheduled batchjob `training-export` spikes at 17:00 UTC which may cause transient pressure.

maria: great — thanks. i'll update INFRA-2345 with reclaimed capacity note and post another async checkin at 15:00 UTC. /cc @infra-oncall
